posts.description: Wafting secret words over dunesSand, grit in the airWe are everywhereAt warWhat’s all this noise, to the breeze?Brisance, the cordite smell of deathThe rubble of these days, the bubbleAll the smashed concrete, the visible bonesYou could dry out alrightYou could let it go, forget it -- or distract yourselfBut that won’t stop it, make it […]
